sights.n: Hokkaido University — Poplar & Ginkgo Avenues (北海道大学 札幌キャンパス)
sights.address: 7 minutes walk from JR Sapporo Station, Kita-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: The 1876 Sapporo Agricultural College campus, 7 minutes from the station — the 1903 Poplar Avenue (replanted after the 2004 typhoon), the ginkgo avenue, and a 1929 scratch-tile museum of 3 million specimens.
